title: Podcasts feature review
description: Review the complete Podcasts feature implementation for correctness, UI convention compliance per CLAUDE.md, and security. Check: no hardcoded hex colors; semantic colors and system fonts only; SF Symbols only; all interactive elements have accessibility labels and ≥44×44pt tap targets; Empty/Loading/Error states present in both PodcastsView and PodcastPlayerView; CF-Access headers on both list API requests and audio stream; AVFoundation observers properly removed in deinit; scrubber isSeeking coordination is correct and does not fight the periodic timer; cursor passed verbatim with no parsing; xcodebuild test passes clean.
acceptance_criteria: No hardcoded hex color values in any new file
All interactive elements have accessibility labels and ≥44×44pt tap targets
CF-Access headers injected for both API requests and audio stream
AVFoundation time observer, KVO, and notification observer all removed in deinit
Empty, Loading, Error, and Not-Configured states present in PodcastsView
xcodebuild test exits 0 with no regressions
